correctness.rationale: Stationary Fourier-generator equations give characteristic functions with common positive denominator and necessary/sufficient aliasing balance. Independent stationary moment balances give the stationary mode fractions and the cross moment E[X eta]. Conditioning on no resets in a lag derives exact covariance at every t>0; positivity and integrated-gap identities follow algebraically. The standalone checker passed 622 symbolic and independently constructed six-dimensional semigroup/Fourier assertions. The theorem depends on exact algebraic proof, not finite numerical tests.

value.rationale: The known distinction between resetting into ballistic and diffusive modes motivates the precise observability question. On a nondegenerate physically interpretable parameter surface, the entire stationary position law coincides across protocols, making every static positional statistic incapable of distinguishing them; exact two-time correlations nevertheless distinguish the hidden protocols at every positive lag, and time-average variances retain an explicit nonzero gap. This is an interpretable identifiability boundary, not arbitrary parameter arithmetic or a routine recomputation of previously tabulated data.
